ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

17. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
